# opnsense_bind_acl (Resource)

Manages a BIND ACL used by views, query policy, recursion and zone transfers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_bind_acl" "internal" {
  name     = "internal-networks"
  networks = ["10.0.0.0/8", "2001:db8:100::/48"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique ACL name.
- `networks` (Set of String) IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR networks in this ACL.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the ACL is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the ACL.
